preconditions.expression: all(line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip())
preconditions.description: Every non-empty line in stdin is a valid integer or space-separated integers.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) >= 1 and all(len(line.split()) == 1 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]) and all(len(line.split()) == int(stdin.splitlines()[i]) for i in [0, 2, 4, ..., len(stdin.splitlines())-1])
preconditions.description: Input follows the format: first line is T (number of test cases), followed by T blocks of 2 lines each: first line is N (number of segments), second line is N space-separated integers (attractiveness values).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(w) <= 10**6 for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2] for w in line.split())
preconditions.description: Each attractiveness value Wi satisfies 1 ≤ Wi ≤ 10^6.

postconditions.expression: stdout.splitlines() == [str(min_velocity) for test_case in [stdin.splitlines()[i+1:i+3] for i in range(0, len(stdin.splitlines()), 2)] for min_velocity in [min_v(test_case)]]
postconditions.description: For each test case, stdout contains exactly one line with the minimal possible initial velocity V1 such that: (1) V1 ≥ W1, (2) for each segment i > 1, Vi ≥ Wi and Vi = Vi-1 - k where k ≥ 1, and (3) Vi ≥ Wi for all i.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line) <= 10**6 for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output velocity is a positive integer within the problem's constraints.
